design.mase_scale_note: mean absolute one-step naive error over the first min_train observations

models.name: Naive (last value)
models.description: Every future month equals the last observed index value.

models.name: Seasonal naive (same month last year)
models.description: Every future month equals the index value of the same calendar month one year earlier.

models.name: Drift (12-month average growth)
models.description: Last value grown at the average monthly growth rate of the previous 12 months.

models.name: ETS (exponential smoothing)
models.description: State-space exponential smoothing fitted to log CPI. Trend (none / additive / damped) and additive seasonality are chosen by AICc on the training window.

models.name: SARIMA
models.description: Seasonal ARIMA with one difference and a drift term, fitted to log CPI. The AR/MA and seasonal AR/MA orders are chosen from a small grid by AICc on the training window.

comparison_sample.rule: common (origin, horizon) pairs for which every model produced a forecast
